board: Keyes KY-009 RGB full-colour LED SMD 5050 module (37-in-1 kit, Joy-IT SEN-KY009RGB and clones), header -, R, G, B, no onboard resistors
reason: Modelled as a three-input actuator (R, G, B anodes, common cathode on -) from the Joy-IT KY-009 data and the arduinomodules.info pinout; no driver needed (plain GPIO/PWM). The board has no series resistors and the spec cannot add them, so the values (180/100 Ohm at 5 V, 150/47 Ohm at 3.3 V) are in the pin descriptions and build notes. Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico.
